verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents an API with OAuth service accounts and operations such as companyCaptable and companyTransactions, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. The note advising API-key users to migrate to service accounts is a credential migration recommendation, not a versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
